actions_or_findings.title: PHR006-B1 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER — backend/app/service/property_admin.py:412-480 — a later CSV row can change a cached parent name without rejection
actions_or_findings.trigger: Import two distinct houses with the same building or unit code but different names for that building or unit.
actions_or_findings.rationale: PHR006-B1 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: name conflicts are checked only when a parent is first loaded. Later rows reuse the cached parent and can commit both houses under the first name, violating conflict rejection. The saved verifier uses matching parent names, so its passing import does not cover this trigger.

actions_or_findings.title: PHR006-B2 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER — backend/app/api/v1/admin_property.py:92-149 — building and unit corrections have no update action
actions_or_findings.trigger: An administrator needs to correct a building or unit name or code after creation.
actions_or_findings.rationale: PHR006-B2 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: the API and miniprogram/pages/supervisor/properties.wxml:15-39 provide building and unit creation, while the only update route and editor target houses. CSV import rejects an existing parent with a changed name. The required building/unit maintenance workflow therefore leaves an operator unable to correct these records.

actions_or_findings.title: PHR006-B3 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER — miniprogram/pages/home/home.js:37 — read-only property users lack the normal page entry
actions_or_findings.trigger: A SUPERVISOR with property:read and resident_relation:read, but without property:manage, opens the home page.
actions_or_findings.rationale: PHR006-B3 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: miniprogram/pages/home/home.wxml:30 hides the sole archive entry unless property:manage is present. The new page itself supports property:read with canEdit=false at miniprogram/pages/supervisor/properties.js:173-183, and backend/app/domain/dev_seed.py:139-142 grants the read permissions to SUPERVISOR. That user cannot reach the intended read-only archive and relation history through normal navigation; the saved page flow exercises an administrator only.

actions_or_findings.title: PHR006-N1 NON_BLOCKING — miniprogram/pages/supervisor/properties.js:84-126 — exported quoted newlines cannot be imported back
actions_or_findings.trigger: An allowed building or unit name contains an embedded newline and its exported CSV is pasted into import.
actions_or_findings.rationale: PHR006-N1 NON_BLOCKING: csvValue quotes newlines, but parseImport splits on newlines before parsing quotes. The round trip fails for that valid value. The saved page flow uses simple single-line names; this edge case has no saved coverage.
